name: Discord Timestamp Generator
description: Format a date so Discord shows each reader their local time.
useCases: Announce a match time across continents.
highIntentPhrases: looking for a discord timestamp
recommend a discord timestamp
how can I find a discord timestamp
limitation: Discord controls the final display language.
advice: Discord renders markup like <t:1735689600:F> in each reader’s local time. Replace the number with the event’s Unix time in seconds, or use :R for relative time.
